mantra_source: Deep prajwalan shlok (paramparik prarthana, deepak jalate samay)

scenes.prompt: Maa Lakshmi seated on a large pink lotus with four arms, red and gold saree, gold crown, beside Shri Ganesh ji, both on a beautifully decorated Diwali puja altar with marigold garlands, a brass kalash with mango leaves and dozens of lit clay diyas, glowing festive night
scenes.animate: a very slow gentle camera push-in, the faces stay still and serene, the diya flames flicker and the soft golden glow gently pulses
scenes.line: माँ लक्ष्मी और गणेश जी की कृपा बनी रहे
scenes.tts: शुभ दीपावली! माँ लक्ष्मी और गणेश जी की कृपा आप पर बनी रहे।
scenes.sub: Shubh Deepawali! Maa Lakshmi aur Ganesh ji ki kripa aap par bani rahe.

scenes.prompt: A beautiful Indian home courtyard on Diwali night, a large colourful rangoli in the centre surrounded by many lit clay diyas, marigold torans, lanterns glowing, warm golden festive light
scenes.animate: the diya flames flicker softly, the lanterns sway very slightly and the camera slowly glides forward
scenes.tts: दीपों की तरह आपका जीवन खुशियों से जगमगाए।
scenes.sub: Deepon ki tarah aapka jeevan khushiyon se jagmagaye.

scenes.prompt: Close view of a single brass diya with a steady bright flame on a decorated puja thali with flowers, rice and kumkum, soft dark background with golden bokeh lights
scenes.mantra: शुभं करोति कल्याणम् आरोग्यं धनसम्पदा। शत्रुबुद्धिविनाशाय दीपज्योतिर्नमोऽस्तु ते॥

scenes.sub: Shubham karoti kalyanam arogyam dhanasampada, shatrubuddhi vinashaya deepajyotir namostu te.

scenes.tts: अपने परिवार को भेजें। जय श्री श्याम!
scenes.sub: Apne parivaar ko bhejein. Subscribe: Shyam Premi SN. Jai Shree Shyam!
